notes:
Inbound SMB lead from indie studio building live social game. CEO: "chat must feel instant — typing latency is product perceived quality." Primary ask: hosted API to avoid infra ops. Key concerns: predictable token costs, robust moderation primitives, and streaming latency. SE (Priya) confirmed Redwood hosted supports streaming + moderation callbacks in principle; raised questions about rate limit tiers and burst policies.

POC plan: 1) small hosted test with synthetic traffic (2k msgs/day) 2) validate moderation webhook and false-positive rates 3) load test to 1k concurrent rooms.

Quoted items: pricing deck (drive link) shared; security FAQ requested by CTO for procurement packet. CTO asked for SOC2 evidence + KMS integration notes. Budget: early-stage ARR target low; wants month-to-month self-serve with option to convert to Dedicated if growth justifies.

Sales notes / shorthand: "CEOs wants it to feel native, not botty"; avoid heavy-handed content filters that kill UX. Follow up: draft sample traffic script, show cost model for streaming vs batch, confirm abuse webhook latency SLA.
